title: Antar Scripture Package Checksums
description: Rules for SHA256SUMS and the combined package checksum. Algorithm is always SHA-256 lowercase hex.

sha256sumsFilenames.description: Exact required filenames in SHA256SUMS, sorted lexicographically when written.

canonicalPackageChecksumOrder.description: packageChecksum = SHA-256(bytes(verses.jsonl) || bytes(provenance.json)) in this order. Manifest is excluded to avoid circular hashing.

sha256sumsLineFormat.description: Compatible with `shasum -a 256` / `sha256sum` verification against files in the package directory.
